summary: Full E2E test of Global Bounty system. Backend: 9/9 pytest tests pass covering config defaults, current shape, admin auth guard, force-new selection, simulate-kill completion, atomic idempotency (double simulate-kill returns ok:false and no duplicate history entry), admin config update+revert, pause/resume, force+cancel, and WebSocket /api/bounty/ws (state frame + ping/pong). Frontend: /bounty renders title 'GLOBAL BOUNTY', bounty-card with Active status, target name, dinosaur, all 3 reward stats (meat/exp/amber), bounty-id starting with BNT-, 'Historial de cacerías' section, admin panel with force/simkill/pause/cancel/cfg-save buttons + config inputs. Admin flow: click force → active bounty; click simkill → bounty-status transitions to 'Completado' and history list grows. Floating bounty-widget renders on /dashboard with target name and does NOT render on /bounty itself. /bounty/overlay renders with transparent background (rgba(0,0,0,0)) and inner bounty-card. No JS console errors during the flow (one transient 500 seen during simkill retry but result was successful).

issues: 'bounty-admin-resume' data-testid only mounts when paused (conditional render). Fine functionally but note for testers: to assert it exists, first pause the bounty.

critical_code_review_comments: bounty.py handlers include the SimKillIn body as required — clients MUST send an empty JSON body {} (returns 422 otherwise). Consider making the body Optional or defaulting to `data: SimKillIn = SimKillIn()` for DX; not a bug.
Autoplay warnings from AudioContext are expected in headless (no user gesture) — not a bug.
One 500 seen in console during rapid admin actions (probably concurrent force+simkill race). Non-fatal, outcome still correct; consider guarding _complete against a very recently cancelled bounty.
test_credentials: POST /api/auth/demo → JWT stored in localStorage key 'primal_token' (role=admin).
seed_data_creation: None persistent; test cancels any active bounty and forces new ones during runs. History records are left in place (expected).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bounty backend endpoints verified via /app/backend/tests/test_bounty.py (9 tests). Simulate-kill requires JSON body {}. WebSocket /api/bounty/ws works and replies 'pong' to 'ping'. Frontend flows verified with Playwright on preview URL. Widget visibility uses route-based hiding: hidden on /bounty and /bounty/overlay, visible elsewhere while a bounty is active.
